shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at 3 on the number line in the left image with the marker at (2, 8) in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The depicted left-side interval excludes its right endpoint 3. Right image: The plotted segment excludes its left endpoint (2, 8).
Rationales: The selected cue in each image excludes the indicated boundary point. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
